hooks.command: test -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.testing/tasks/current" || exit 0; f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$f" in *test*|*spec*|*__tests__*|*/.testing/*) exit 0 ;; *) echo "testsquad: a testing task is in flight. $f is product code -- report the defect, do not edit it to make a test pass." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
